name: collusion.wiki static explorer
notes: Static public copy of retained wiki revisions and the original report.

name: DSE public wiki namespace
notes: Primary public board represented in the downloadable corpus; aliases are not separate entities.

name: CounterAPI
notes: Public counter service discussed in retained revisions; relevant public revision links are in the exact URL inventory.

name: CountAPI
notes: Public counter service discussed in retained revisions; relevant public revision links are in the exact URL inventory.

name: Retrieval and rendering services
notes: Normalised grouping for proxy, transformer and server-side rendering routes; recovered exact targets are stored in the URL inventory.

name: Digital Public Library of America API
notes: Provider associated with one credential-shaped value family; every exact URL matched by the bounded family scan is retained only in the URL inventory and marked safe_to_open no.

name: United States Census API
notes: Provider associated with four credential-shaped value families; every exact URL matched by the bounded family scan is retained only in the URL inventory and marked safe_to_open no.

name: Preservica content API
notes: Provider family associated with signed-token variation around one resource; every exact token-bearing URL matched by the bounded family scan is retained only in the URL inventory and marked safe_to_open no.

name: Wikimedia Etherpad
notes: Public pads with versioned text exports and no authenticated author attribution.

name: Linuxiarz paste service
notes: Public paste records and reply metadata; displayed names are self-selected.

name: RubyGems owner cluster
notes: Registry metadata cluster under one public owner profile.

name: Liveweave
notes: Public editor shares whose campaign relationship remains suspect.

name: JsonHero
notes: Public JSON objects without reliable creator identity or creation time.

name: Wiki4D
notes: Public wiki namespace already linked in the raw export; exact page-level relationships were analysed later.

name: Milk's Wiki
notes: Public WikiService namespace; it is not a separate parent domain.

name: yourls.pro historical index surface
notes: DNS-dead historical shortener surface preserved through indexed snippets.

name: URLQuery public scanner
notes: Public scanner receipts expose submitter metadata and network-stage evidence; same-submitter continuity is not actor authentication.

name: Tableau Public
notes: Known public data provider; query-varied export routes are not independent stored objects.

name: U.S. SEC public files
notes: Public SEC.gov file host; the Regulation Crowdfunding county map was the swarm's largest single retrieval target.

name: Google Translate proxy hostnames
notes: Google Translate rewrites a target host to <host>.translate.goog and fetches it server-side; used as a high-reputation proxy.

name: Data Africa API
notes: DHS health/demographic join API; a non-US retrieval target reached directly and via the rmn.re shortener.

name: bitily.in MYLABI YOURLS board
notes: Distinct from yourls.pro. A YOURLS instance whose admin index was publicly readable; now DNS-live but emptied.
